purpose: Compare the selected 20-step style teacher with the unmodified official PixArt-Sigma base under matched conditions.

protocol.clip_metric: mean text-image alignment score over the 30 generated images
protocol.cmmd_reference: first 100 images from the validated local ink-wash reference archive
protocol.cmmd_kernel: Gaussian RBF over normalized CLIP image embeddings

interpretation.clip_score: The selected teacher has higher mean prompt-image alignment than the official base on the matched 30-prompt benchmark.
interpretation.cmmd: The selected teacher is closer to the local ink-wash reference distribution under this CLIP-kernel statistic.
interpretation.limitation: CLIPScore is not a direct style-fidelity or human-preference metric; model selection also used CMMD and visual review.

cross_stage_warning: Do not compare these absolute scores directly with the distillation table: Stage 2 uses a different held-out prompt set and guidance configuration.
